Bbr Partners Has Decreased Its Holding in Albemarle (ALB) by $836,549; Maryland Capital Management Continues to Hold Position in A T & T (T)
April 28, 2018 - By reb123z
Maryland Capital Management increased its stake in A T & T Inc (T) by 6.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maryland Capital Management bought 12,547 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 205,742 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.00 million, up from 193,195 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maryland Capital Management who had been investing in A T & T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $214.60B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.18% or $0.06 $33.04. About 54.21 million shares traded or 85.82% up from the average. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Bbr Partners Llc decreased its stake in Albemarle Corp (ALB) by 40.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bbr Partners Llc sold 6,587 shares as the company’s stock declined 27.74% with the market. The hedge fund held 9,731 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.24 million, down from 16,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bbr Partners Llc who had been investing in Albemarle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.74 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.4 $96.95. About 857,223 shares traded. Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) has declined 10.68% downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.23% the S&P500.
Analysts await Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) to report earnings on May, 9 after the close. They expect $1.20 earnings per share, up 14.29% or $0.15 from last year’s $1.05 per share. ALB’s profit will be $132.87M for 20.20 P/E if the $1.20 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.34 actual earnings per share reported by Albemarle Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -10.45% negative EPS growth.
Among 23 analysts covering Albemarle Corporation ( NYSE:ALB ), 16 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 70% are positive. Albemarle Corporation had 78 analyst reports since August 7, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Monday, February 5 by Seaport Global. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Citigroup on Thursday, March 1. The company was upgraded on Monday, January 8 by Robert W. Baird. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, November 9 by RBC Capital Markets. The stock has “Overweight” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Thursday, March 1. The company was downgraded on Wednesday, August 9 by Suntrust Robinson. On Monday, October 23 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Buy” rating and $149.0 target in Tuesday, October 17 report. RBC Capital Markets maintained Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) rating on Friday, March 17. RBC Capital Markets has “Outperform” rating and $132 target. On Monday, April 18 the stock rating was maintained by Citigroup with “Buy”.
Bbr Partners Llc, which manages about $7.35 billion and $533.09M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Procter & Gamble Co (NYSE:PG) by 25,663 shares to 34,861 shares, valued at $3.20M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Tocagen Inc by 40,395 shares in the quarter, for a total of 54,887 shares, and has risen its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB).
